description: Ancho de las calles del término municipal de Granollers is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Map of widths of the sidewalks and roads of the municipality. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Street Widths of the municipality of Granollers" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
